units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 26:10">Targ. Ez. XXVI, 10</cite> <he>רִפְסַת</he> constr. (h. text <he>שפעת</he>).
B. Mets. 79ᵇ ר׳ דספינתא Ms. M. (ed. רִפְסְתָא, or רִפְסָתָא, pl.) the injury done to the ship by the shaking (attendant upon unloading and loading).

<cite ref="Eruvin 40b:16">Erub. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>אמר ליה דליוה לרטיבא ר׳ לי בדוכתיה</he> Ar. (Ms. M. <he>דפסא</he>; ed. <he>דלויה … ר׳ ליה וכ׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he said, carry the green date, I have a press on the spot, i.e. you came to find out my opinion, you will soon have an opportunity to learn it (differ. in comment.).
